recipe.visualDefinition: A high-contrast, close-up portrait of a man in a dark suit against a deep blue background with diagonal shadow patterns. The composition is anchored by a massive, vertically-oriented serif nameplate on the left edge, overlaid with a small, vibrant script subtitle.
coreVisualRelationships: Vertical text block balances the off-center facial placement
Warm skin tones contrast against the cool cobalt and navy background
Sharp lighting on the face mimics the diagonal lines in the backdrop
Small orange script provides a focal point against the large cream serif letters
coreInvariants: Deep blue background with diagonal light/shadow bands
Chiaroscuro lighting on the subject's face
High-contrast white shirt collar and cuffs

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Subject occupies the right two-thirds of the frame, medium-close-up scale.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large vertical typography on the left margin.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the large vertical text, move to the orange script, then follow the subject's gaze and the diagonal background lines.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Dense composition with minimal negative space; background is textured with light play.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep cobalt and navy blue (background and shadows)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value contrast between the dark suit/background and the bright text/shirt; saturated blues.
paletteRestrictions: Avoid pure black; use deep navy for shadows
Limit to blue, cream, and one warm accent

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Classical high-contrast serif and casual brush script
letterConstructionRules: Primary text is rotated 90 degrees counter-clockwise
Letters are tightly tracked to form a solid vertical column
Secondary script is small, slanted, and overlaps the primary text
characterSpecificRedesigns: Vertical strokes in the serif font are significantly thicker than horizontals

typesetting.lineBreakPattern: Single word or name per line

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Extreme contrast: rigid, large, vertical serif paired with fluid, small, horizontal script.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the high-contrast vertical strokes and sharp serifs
Captures the casual, handwritten feel of the accent text

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a portrait of a man in a dark suit and white shirt, lit with dramatic side-lighting. The background should be deep cobalt blue with diagonal shadows. Leave the left 25% of the frame relatively clear for text placement.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add the primary name in a large, vertical, cream-colored Modern Serif font on the left. Overlay a small, horizontal, orange brush script title across the middle of the vertical text.

verificationChecks: Is the primary text rotated exactly 90 degrees?
Does the orange script overlap the cream text?
Is the lighting on the face high-contrast?
Is the background blue with diagonal patterns?

adjustableVariables: Specific shade of blue in the background
Exact placement of the script overlap
mustRedesign: Do not use the specific name 'Bill Medley'
Do not use the specific title 'Going Home'
Avoid exact replication of the subject's facial features
postGenerationChecks: Ensure vertical text is aligned to the left edge
Verify the orange accent color pops against the blue/cream
Confirm diagonal background shadows are present
recipe.reuseFormula: Vertical Serif Nameplate + Overlaid Script + Chiaroscuro Portrait + Blue Diagonal Background
